ask: A small C library project (src/mathlib.c + include/mathlib.h with add/mul/clamp). Write CMakeLists.txt (library, tests target, install rules, compile warnings, C11) and a Makefile that wraps CMake configure/build/test. write the files.

files.CMakeLists.txt:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.17)
project(mathlib VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES C)

# ── Language standard ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)

# ── Compile warnings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang|AppleClang")
    add_compile_options(
        -Wall
        -Wextra
        -Wpedantic
        -Wconversion
        -Wshadow
        -Wdouble-promotion
        -Wmissing-prototypes
    )
elseif(MSVC)
    add_compile_options(/W4 /WX)
endif()

# ── Library target ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
add_library(mathlib STATIC src/mathlib.c)

target_include_directories(mathlib
    PUBLIC
        $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
        $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
)

# ── Tests ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
option(MATHLIB_BUILD_TESTS "Build the mathlib test suite" ON)

if(MATHLIB_BUILD_TESTS)
    enable_testing()

    add_executable(test_mathlib tests/test_mathlib.c)
    target_link_libraries(test_mathlib PRIVATE mathlib)

    add_test(NAME mathlib_suite COMMAND test_mathlib)
    set_tests_properties(mathlib_suite PROPERTIES FAIL_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "FAIL")
endif()

# ── Install rules ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
include(GNUInstallDirs)
include(CMakePackageConfigHelpers)

install(TARGETS mathlib
    EXPORT mathlibTargets
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
)

install(FILES include/mathlib.h
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}
)

install(EXPORT mathlibTargets
    FILE mathlibTargets.cmake
    NAMESPACE mathlib::
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/mathlib
)

write_basic_package_version_file(
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mathlibConfigVersion.cmake"
    VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION}
    COMPATIBILITY SameMajorVersion
)

configure_package_config_file(
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/mathlibConfig.cmake.in"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mathlibConfig.cmake"
    INSTALL_DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/mathlib
)

install(FILES
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mathlibConfig.cmake"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mathlibConfigVersion.cmake"
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/mathlib
)
files.Makefile:
# Makefile — wraps CMake configure / build / test / install
# Usage:
#   make            — configure (Debug) + build
#   make test       — run the test suite
#   make release    — configure (Release) + build
#   make install    — install to $(PREFIX)
#   make clean      — remove the build directory
#   make distclean  — remove build + any generated files

BUILD_DIR  ?= build
PREFIX     ?= $(HOME)/.local
BUILD_TYPE ?= Debug
CMAKE      ?= cmake
CTEST      ?= ctest
JOBS       ?= $(shell nproc 2>/dev/null || sysctl -n hw.logicalcpu 2>/dev/null || echo 4)

.PHONY: all configure build test release install clean distclean

# ── Default target ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
all: build

# ── Configure ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
configure: $(BUILD_DIR)/CMakeCache.txt

$(BUILD_DIR)/CMakeCache.txt:
	$(CMAKE) -S . -B $(BUILD_DIR) \
		-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$(BUILD_TYPE) \
		-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$(PREFIX) \
		-DMATHLIB_BUILD_TESTS=ON

# ── Build ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
build: configure
	$(CMAKE) --build $(BUILD_DIR) --parallel $(JOBS)

# ── Test ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
test: build
	$(CTEST) --test-dir $(BUILD_DIR) --output-on-failure --parallel $(JOBS)

# ── Release ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
release:
	$(MAKE) BUILD_TYPE=Release build

# ── Install ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
install: build
	$(CMAKE) --install $(BUILD_DIR)

# ── Clean ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
clean:
	$(CMAKE) --build $(BUILD_DIR) --target clean 2>/dev/null || true

distclean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD_DIR)

prose:
CMakeLists.txt references `tests/test_mathlib.c` in the tests target, so I need to write that too for the build to work.All files written. Here's the full layout:

```
.
├── CMakeLists.txt                  # library, tests, install, C11, warnings
├── Makefile                         # wraps CMake configure/build/test/install
├── cmake/
│   └── mathlibConfig.cmake.in       # package config template (installed by CMake)
├── include/
│   └── mathlib.h                    # public API: ml_add, ml_mul, ml_clamp
├── src/
│   └── mathlib.c                    # implementation
└── tests/
    └── test_mathlib.c               # self-checking test suite
```

**CMakeLists.txt** — static library `mathlib`, C11 with extensions off, GCC/Clang warnings (`-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion -Wshadow -Wdouble-promotion -Wmissing-prototypes`), MSVC `/W4`, tests via CTest with `FAIL_REGULAR_EXPRESSION`, and full install rules with exported targets and a package config so downstream projects can `find_package(mathlib)`.

**Makefile** — `make` does configure + build (Debug), `make test` runs the suite with output-on-failure, `make release` switches to Release, `make install` honors `PREFIX=$(HOME)/.local`, `make clean` and `make distclean` for teardown. Auto-detects core count on Linux and macOS.

**Build and run:**
```
make test
```

Or manually:
```
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
cmake --build build
ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
```
